In which year was the Zillabandi system introduced in Hyderabad State?
x:
The Zillabandi System was introduced in 1863 by Salar Jung I as part of his administrative reforms in Hyderabad State. The reform divided the state into districts (Zillas) for efficient administration and improved revenue collection and governance.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

s: Sathiraju Lakshrninarayana is the birth name of one of the following artists
x:
The celebrated Telugu artist, film director and illustrator Bapu was originally named Satthiraju Lakshminarayana. He gained immense popularity for his distinctive artistic style, elegant line drawings and memorable illustrations depicting characters from the Ramayana, Mahabharata and Telugu culture. Apart from painting, he directed several classic Telugu films in collaboration with Mullapudi Venkata Ramana. Bapu is regarded as one of the greatest artists in modern Telugu culture.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
